name: Nathan Lau
employer: University of Toronto
evidenceNote: VT profile professional history lists Human Factors Engineer at NuScale Power 2010-2011, Post-doctoral Fellow at the University of Toronto 2011-2012, Senior Scientist at the University of Virginia 2012-2014 and VT Assistant Professor from 2014. Virginia Tech News (November 2014) says he earned his Toronto doctorate in 2012 and was a postdoctoral fellow for a year in Toronto's Human Factors and Applied Statistics Laboratory before two years at UVA. Overlap: the explicitly post-doctoral fellowship (2011-2012) began before the 2012 degree date and is treated as the first post-PhD job under the overlap rule; months are not given.
reason: Dated profile history plus a university hiring announcement give a postdoctoral fellowship spanning the 2012 conferral as the first post-doctoral job; the earlier NuScale engineering job (2010-2011) ended before the degree.

name: Tao Sun
employer: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR), Singapore
evidenceNote: VT profile lists the University of Hong Kong Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering (2006-2010) and a dated professional history starting with Scientist I at A*STAR, Singapore, November 2011 - April 2018, then Scientist II (A*STAR, 2018), MIT Media Lab Research Scientist (2018-2020), Northwell Health Staff Scientist (2020-2021), West Virginia University Research Assistant Professor (2021-2023) and VT from June 2023. No position is listed between the end of the doctorate (2010) and November 2011.
reason: Dated profile chronology gives A*STAR (a Singapore government research agency) as the earliest post-PhD position; the 2010-2011 gap is unexplained and the HKU conferral date could not be checked (HKU Scholars Hub refused automated requests).
